text:
maya: flagging an issue noticed at ~08:02 UTC: a subset of trial tenants saw duplicate onboarding events and delayed profile creation. error rate spiked to ~18% on the batch-ingest worker for EU region. need customer comms, a quick mitigation plan, and credit calc.
liam (eng): on it. initial triage shows transient backpressure from our downstream profile-service causing retries without idempotency checks. pushing a small guard to check for existing profile_id before create, ETA 20m. will canary.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated by liam 1: small-fix/idempotency-guard v0.3 (canary 10%).
zoe (revops): i'll precompute credits. propose simple formula for trials: $0.50 per 1000 failed/duplicate events, min $5 credit. keeping it conservative. will output a csv for accounting.
ryan (acct exec): please flag three renewal-churn candidates: Nimbus Labs, HelixCare, DataWeave. priority outreach if impacted; i'll join the thread for high-touch.
liam (eng): canary looks good; error rate down ~75% for canary hosts. full rollout in progress. short-term mitigation for customers: enable consumer-side idempotency (idempotency_key) or run a dedupe SQL against recent events table: 
```sql
-- dedupe by external_batch_id, keep latest
delete from onboarding_events a using onboarding_events b
where a.id < b.id and a.external_batch_id = b.external_batch_id;
```
ops-bot: detected rollout success: small-fix/idempotency-guard v0.3 fully rolled out.
maya: thanks. drafting outreach: need to be concise and action-focused. include 1) what happened 2) what we did 3) how customers can self-remediate 4) credit + next steps 5) how to book help.
zoe (revops): CSV prepared for impacted trials, linking totals. will send credit confirmations within 72 hours with a unique confirmation number.
ryan (acct exec): for the three flagged accounts, please route as "high-touch" and cc me. i'll offer an SE pairing session and reassure about renewal messaging.
liam (eng): adding short RCA blurb for the email: "root cause: downstream profile-service backpressure exposed lack of idempotency on the batch-ingest path; fix: add pre-create existence check and backpressure-aware retry with jitter; mitigation: immediate rollback of duplicate writes and optional dedupe script provided."
maya: draft outreach below (short): "Hi — we identified and resolved an issue that affected onboarding for a subset of trial accounts between 08:0208:27 UTC. We deployed a fix and ingestion has returned to normal. If you observed duplicated profiles, we can run a dedupe for you or you can run the attached SQL. We're offering a complimentary 45-minute onboarding healthcheck and a credit for impacted events. We'll follow up with a confirmation and credit id within 72 hours. Reply to this message or book time here: <cal.link/45min>." feedback?
ryan (acct exec): looks good. include a line to avoid alarming customers about renewals: "This is limited to onboarding events and does not affect billing or production data."
zoe (revops): added credit wording in-line: "Credits are automatic for verified duplicates; amount equals $0.50 per 1000 affected events (minimum $5)."
liam (eng): small note for self-remediate instructions: add example curl for idempotency header: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/onboard -H "Idempotency-Key: <batch_id>" -d '{"events": ...}'
```
maya: perfect. i'll send segmented outreach to impacted trial tenants in EU+US within 30 minutes and prioritize the three high-touch accounts. zoe, please attach CSV/credit next steps. liam, thanks for the fast patch.
ops-bot: incident closed: small-fix/idempotency-guard v0.3 rolled successfully across regions.
liam (eng): posting a short postmortem to the incident board with timeline and follow-ups (add a permanent idempotency test in CI, and telemetry for retry patterns).
maya: closing loop here. will aggregate responses and share exec summary once credits are confirmed. if anyone gets a reply that requests immediate assistance, please escalate to me or ryan.
